tokens.name: enamel
tokens.usage: Desk ground behind all sub-panels under finish 1. Smooth satin paint.

tokens.name: enamel-panel
tokens.usage: Finish 1, satin grey-green enamel: sub-panel ground. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: enamel-edge
tokens.usage: 3px border of every sub-panel, screw outlines.

tokens.name: enamel-recess
tokens.usage: Blanking plates and spare positions.

tokens.name: finish-ivory
tokens.usage: Finish 2, satin ivory enamel: sub-panel ground. Text on it is ink-on-ivory.

tokens.name: finish-ivory-edge
tokens.usage: Finish 2: sub-panel border and screw recess.

tokens.name: ink-on-ivory
tokens.usage: Painted text on finish-ivory.

tokens.name: finish-graphite
tokens.usage: Finish 3, matte graphite paint: sub-panel ground. Text on it is ink-on-graphite.

tokens.name: finish-graphite-edge
tokens.usage: Finish 3: sub-panel border and screw recess.

tokens.name: ink-on-graphite
tokens.usage: Painted text on finish-graphite.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text painted directly on enamel: session numerals, units, scale captions.

tokens.name: bakelite
tokens.usage: Label plates, round button caps, meter housings, fuse caps.

tokens.name: engraving
tokens.usage: Engraved lettering on bakelite. Never on enamel.

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: Borders of windows, buttons, nixie filters, drum counters.

tokens.name: aluminium
tokens.usage: Chrome collars, toggle body, factory nameplate.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Designator tag ground. Text on it is tag-ink.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Designator text on tag.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Pencil strips and card inserts. Text on it is tag-ink.

tokens.name: instruction
tokens.usage: Riveted instruction plates. Text on it is tag-ink.

tokens.name: meter-face
tokens.usage: Yellowed meter dial. Scale and needle are tag-ink.

tokens.name: lamp-red-on
tokens.usage: Lit red window: operator must act. Lettering ink-red-on.

tokens.name: lamp-red-hot
tokens.usage: The two soft bulb hot spots inside a lit red window; the centre of a lit red cap.

tokens.name: lamp-red-off
tokens.usage: Dark red window. Lettering ink-red-off.

tokens.name: lamp-green-on
tokens.usage: Lit green window or lens: working, on, power present. Lettering ink-green-on.

tokens.name: lamp-green-off
tokens.usage: Dark green window or lens. Lettering ink-green-off.

tokens.name: lamp-amber-on
tokens.usage: Lit amber: abnormal but not urgent. Also the hazard stripe. Lettering ink-amber-on.

tokens.name: lamp-amber-off
tokens.usage: Dark amber window. Lettering ink-amber-off.

tokens.name: lamp-white-on
tokens.usage: Lit white (yellowed) window or lens: plain status. Lettering ink-white-on.

tokens.name: lamp-white-off
tokens.usage: Dark white window, lens or cap. Lettering ink-white-off.

tokens.name: lamp-green-hot
tokens.usage: The two soft bulb hot spots inside a lit green window.

tokens.name: lamp-amber-hot
tokens.usage: The two soft bulb hot spots inside a lit amber window.

tokens.name: lamp-white-hot
tokens.usage: The two soft bulb hot spots inside a lit white window; the centre of a lit cream cap.

tokens.name: ink-red-off
tokens.usage: Light lettering on dark red glass. Lettering never changes between light and dark ink; it only takes on the lamp's light.

tokens.name: ink-red-on
tokens.usage: The same lettering with the red lamp lit behind it: warmer and brighter, with a faint halo.

tokens.name: ink-green-off
tokens.usage: Light lettering on dark green glass.

tokens.name: ink-green-on
tokens.usage: The same lettering with the green lamp lit.

tokens.name: ink-amber-off
tokens.usage: Dark lettering on dark amber glass.

tokens.name: ink-amber-on
tokens.usage: The same lettering with the amber lamp lit: light leaks through the paint and turns it brown.

tokens.name: ink-white-off
tokens.usage: Dark lettering on dark white glass and on cream button caps.

tokens.name: ink-white-on
tokens.usage: The same lettering with the white lamp lit: warm umber.

tokens.name: ink-light-off
tokens.usage: Trial variant 'all lettering light': unlit glass of any colour.

tokens.name: ink-light-on
tokens.usage: Trial variant 'all lettering light': lit glass. Fails on lit amber and white; kept to show why.

tokens.name: ink-dark-off
tokens.usage: Trial variant 'all lettering dark': unlit glass of any colour.

tokens.name: ink-dark-on
tokens.usage: Trial variant 'all lettering dark': lit glass.

tokens.name: nixie-glass
tokens.usage: Shared orange filter window behind a row of digits.

tokens.name: nixie-glow
tokens.usage: The lit cathode digit.

tokens.name: nixie-halo
tokens.usage: Glow colour around a lit digit.

tokens.name: drum-wheel
tokens.usage: Digit wheel of an electromechanical counter. Digits are drum-ink.

tokens.name: drum-ink
tokens.usage: Digits printed on drum wheels.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Grounding bolt, bulb bases.

tokens.name: stockroom-red
tokens.usage: Hand-painted inventory number only.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title plate of a sub-panel. Always uppercase.

styles.name: plate
styles.usage: Row and group label plates. Uppercase, centred.

styles.name: plate-sm
styles.usage: Plates under buttons, meters, counters; instruction plates.

styles.name: designator
styles.usage: Schematic reference on aluminium tags and inside windows (10px there).

styles.name: session-numeral
styles.usage: Column numbers over the annunciator; selector positions use 26px.

styles.name: window
styles.usage: Lettering on lamp windows: 13px on one line, 12px when the label takes two lines.

styles.name: button-cap
styles.usage: Three or four letters on a button cap.

styles.name: scale
styles.usage: Meter scale numbers and unit captions.

styles.name: inventory
styles.usage: Stockroom paint, rotated -3 degrees. One per console.

styles.name: pencil
styles.usage: What the operator writes on a pencil strip. Colour #4a4a48.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its designator tag; between ON/OFF lenses label and lens.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between annunciator windows and rows; plate padding inline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sub-panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sub-panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between groups inside a sub-panel; button grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between instrument columns.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Bakelite plates, instruction plates, pencil strips.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Lamp windows, nixie filters, drum counters, blanking plates.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Sub-panels.

tokens.name: radius-meter
tokens.usage: Meter housings and dial faces.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Square pushbutton caps. Round buttons and lenses are full circles.

tokens.name: glow-red
tokens.usage: Light a lit red lamp spills onto the paint around it: wide, faint, never a neon outline. Stronger when the room is dark.

tokens.name: glow-green
tokens.usage: Light a lit green lamp spills onto the paint around it: wide, faint, never a neon outline. Stronger when the room is dark.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: Light a lit amber lamp spills onto the paint around it: wide, faint, never a neon outline. Stronger when the room is dark.

tokens.name: glow-white
tokens.usage: Light a lit white lamp spills onto the paint around it: wide, faint, never a neon outline. Stronger when the room is dark.

tokens.name: glow-nixie
tokens.usage: Text glow of a lit digit.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Depth inside the nixie filter window.

tokens.name: cap-up
tokens.usage: Shadow a button cap standing proud of its hole throws on the bezel.

tokens.name: cap-down
tokens.usage: Shadow the hole throws on a cap that has sunk into it.

tokens.name: plate-raise
tokens.usage: Drop shadow of anything screwed onto the enamel: plates, tags, instruction plates, meter housings, dial plates.

tokens.name: recess
tokens.usage: Shadow the bezel throws onto glass set behind it: windows, nixie filters, drum windows, meter dials.

tokens.name: panel-raise
tokens.usage: Drop shadow of a whole sub-panel on the desk.

tokens.name: window-w
tokens.usage: Width of every LampWindow on the console, bezel included (glass 88px). There is only one window size.

tokens.name: window-h
tokens.usage: Height of every LampWindow on the console, bezel included (glass 38px).

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Square and round pushbutton outer size.

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: Round lamp lens including its 6px chrome collar.

tokens.name: tube-w
tokens.usage: One nixie digit cell. XL 54px.

tokens.name: tube-h
tokens.usage: One nixie digit cell. XL 84px.

tokens.name: drum-cell-w
tokens.usage: One drum wheel.

tokens.name: drum-cell-h
tokens.usage: One drum wheel window.

tokens.name: bezel-w
tokens.usage: Border of windows and counters. Buttons 5px, nixie filter 4px.
